title: tzvelevopyrethrum khorassanicum
intro: Tzvelevopyrethrum khorassanicum, commonly known as Persian pyrethrum or Persian chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the sunflower family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve sleep quality, and alleviate anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Tzvelevopyrethrum khorassanicum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include pyrethrins, flavonoids, and terpenoids, that have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the plant's potential therapeutic applications and confirm its safety for human use.
